title: Fantastic habit tracker!
body:

To make it a flawless experience, I’d love to see some future updates to the iOS widgets:

Interactive Main Widget: It would be amazing to check off habits right from the home screen, maybe with a fun visual pulse and a toggleable chime!

Quick-Append Journal Widget: A "Today" widget to quickly add a timestamp and note would be a game-changer for quick time tracking and combatting time blindness.

Overall, it's a beautifully built app with a fantastic foundation. Can't wait to see what the developers do next!

title: Love it, almost perfect.
body:

I'm really hoping for the "Templates" update to the journal, that you will implement some kind of system that automatically creates a recurring note for an individual habit. I have a habit for "Lifting" at the gym. I like that there is an option to add a note with a checklist to it to tick which target areas I did that day. The only thing is I have to recreate the checklist each day. It's so close to being optimal, if templates could automatically recur each day for people with checklists inside of specific habits, and log which items on the checklist were completed while refreshing for the next day, I think this app would be perfect.

Also maybe the ability to hide the streak count for specific habits from the home menu, and capitalized words for the custom units just for neatness sake.

title: Good with a few flaws
body:
This app is generally really good and it’s helped me a lot since getting it. But there’s one pretty significant feature missing, and it’s an option to pause habits and not lose your streak. For example if you become sick or go on a vacation and you can’t follow your regular habits and routine. It makes me feel guilty for losing my streaks, but like sometimes your routine has routine has to change for a few days! I feel like this would be fairly easy to implement and would make the app almost perfect to me. 

A way to set goals to be for a set amount of time (like exercising for 30 min for example) but still be able to check it off just once and not have to check off all the minutes would also be great. If my goal is to exercise for 30 min, I’m gonna do it all at once. I don’t want to have the click the check mark a bunch of times to get to it completed. 

If those two features were added it would be a perfect 5 stars to me!

title: A ton of potential!
body:
This app has a lot of potential and I will keep using it but it has to major flaws when it comes to habit tracking.

1 - you can’t track using decimals. So if you walk 0.5 miles you’re forced to either not track it or round up. Both bad options. Same would go for tracking drinks, water intake etc.

2 - you can’t archive habits. So if you have a short term goal you’re working on, once it’s completed you either have to delete it or just have it cluttering the screen. Another major con for me.

Otherwise it has a lot of good features and is worth the $20 for the year but I will continue searching for something that has a little more flexibility in tracking individual habits.

author: Sadiects

title: Loving it so far!
body: I’ve been using the app for a while now and I’m really liking it. I’ve been using it more for breaking habits than building and it’s been really helpful to be able to make notes about the circumstances when I slip up. It could use a few improvements (the biggest one I would like is some more freedom on color choice. Letting us enter our own hex code would be awesome, but even just a bit more of the spectrum to choose from would be nice), but the dev is very nice and communicative so I’m sure there will be some good updates in the future. 🙂 (Also, I’m still really excited that it has my favorite font  - Montserrat. 😉)
author: Biyxtren

title: Smooth and Snappy
body: After using this app for about 2 weeks, I’ve found it’s very intuitive and easy to use. It keeps me on track with its notifications and the apple Health integration has made my gym habit tracking basically automatic which is great. The UI is nice and easy to use and feel really snappy to navigate through. The premium pricing is great as well, even though I have lifetime access, I believe this is well worth the money. The only thing its missing for me is home screen widgets, which the developer has assured me are coming in a future update so I’m very much looking forward forward to that!

author: Black Star Freak

title: Just got it, but love it so far!
body:
I’m really impressed with the thoroughness and attention to details on the features and types of habits.

Loves:
- I love the automatic tracking of steps, calories, etc. via health and Apple Watch especially! I loaded that up and it picked up historical data. I love being able to see the stats! 
- Letting the user choose day of the week to start week on
- incorporating of activity and adhoc notes into the journal

Will update over time :)
